figurative_meaning_en: To be on the verge of death; to become the cause of destruction
example_sentences_in_bangla: বদসঙ্গের প্রভাবে তার জীবনের কাল হয়েছে।
এই ভুল সিদ্ধান্ত তার কাল হবে।
example_sentences_in_english: Bad company has become the death of him.
This wrong decision will be his downfall.
note: The idiom often warns against negative influences leading to ruin.
